Name: Drop Item Hotkey
Author: Xvordan
Description:
Simply mimics the behavior of the delete key which is a shortcut to dropping items in the trash. Pick up an item from your inventory, hit the backspace key (configurable), rather than clicking outside the inventory.

Made mainly for my personal use, but figured someone else *might* find it of interest.

Manifest.Name: Drop Item Hotkey
Manifest.Description: Press a configurable hotkey (Backspace by default) to drop the item currently held by your cursor, including when picking items up from any inventory menu or when your bags are full.
Manifest.Author: Xvordan
